plan: A prince jungler who charges at his target with his flag and traps it in an arena.
aSurveiller: His E then Q combo. He plants his flag then dashes to it, knocking you up: move away when the flag lands near you.
contrer: Move away from the flag (E): he is about to dash to it with his Q.
Inside his arena (R), use a movement spell to jump over the wall.
He is mostly strong early: avoid fights early on.
faiblesses: Relies on his combo to engage.
His arena can be jumped over.

sorts.P: First attack on a target: bonus damage.
sorts.E: Plants his flag; more attack speed.
sorts.R: Leaps and traps the area in an arena.

momentFort: Very strong from the start, dangerous from level 6.
